comment: Differences between Chromium 156 and the native engine that tests/abi/resize_observation.py records instead of failing. Approved by root for #55 (G10).

differences.devicePixel.statuses: The engine has no device-pixel-content-box (webkit.org/b/219005, Ranvier.WebCore#146): rv_observer_observe_box returns RV_ERR_UNSUPPORTED and every entry has hasDevicePixel 0; Chromium observes it and reports devicePixelContentBoxSize.
differences.devicePixel.log: As devicePixel.statuses: the unsupported observations deliver nothing natively.
differences.observerOrder.log: WebKit delivers observers in the order of their first observe; Chromium, as the specification, in the order of their construction. Every other scenario observes in construction order.
differences.contentBox.entries.z.rect: zoom: 2: WebKit reports contentRect's x and y, the padding offset, in zoomed pixels (4, 20); Chromium in the element's CSS pixels (2, 10). Its width, height and box sizes agree.
differences.depth.log: The loop error reaches the window's error event at the same point, but the native ErrorEvent message is the sanitized 'Script error.'; Chromium's is 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications.'.
